subject.title: feat(codex): fork upstream-linked sessions at a message via thread/fork

question: Should OpenClaw permanently expose the new generic `AgentHarness.sessionFork` and upstream-link mutation contracts as public plugin SDK surface for harness-owned session forks?
rationale: This is a new cross-plugin lifecycle API and persisted-session ownership contract; code review alone cannot choose its long-term public compatibility commitment.

options.title: Approve the generic harness seam
options.body: Keep the capability public, with focused compatibility coverage and real Codex-session proof before merge.

options.title: Keep the feature Codex-local for now
options.body: Avoid publishing the SDK contract until another harness demonstrates a shared abstraction need.

options.title: Pause for API design review
options.body: Define ownership, failure, and lifecycle guarantees for external harness implementations before accepting the public API.

recommendation.title: Approve the generic harness seam
recommendation.body: Keep the capability public, with focused compatibility coverage and real Codex-session proof before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: The supplied merged-feature and current-PR history connect this person most directly to the session-fork architecture.
